description: Amazing opportunity to build your dream home On almost 10 acres. Grading has been completed for your buildWell is in place private drivewayEasy access to I-80 Enjoy the views.

"Great house in a wonderful neighborhood! Walking into this house you will feel the comfort and open concept that makes it both a great home to entertain in as well as relax and enjoy family. The home is clean and ready for your creative choices to make it your own. With an enclosed patio which serves as a beautiful rumpus/entertainment room you can play or enjoy your favorite hobbies. 3 nice size bedrooms and 2 baths located at the back of the house give you good separation. The backyard is just the right size to have fun entertain or just sit and enjoy a beautiful day in Pinole. You certainly wont get tired of the fantastic view of San Pablo Bay from the privacy of your backyard. All of this is just minutes from the freeway and shopping. It is a fantastic spot to call home!"

"Light-filled mid-century 3 BR 2 BA home in the heart of Pinole Valley. Beautiful refinished hardwood floors thruout (except kitchen & family rm). Popcorn ceiling removed new interior paint thruout. Cedar floors in all closets. Eat-in kitchen. Family has owned since 1963. Family rm added around mid-1960s features a wall of hand-hewn paving stones from the streets of SF dating back to 1800’s. Each stone lovingly hand selected by owner was installed by a master stone mason. Wood-burning fireplace in living rm. & wood-burning stove in family rm. Situated on over 1/4 acre of land the back yard is serene w/mature trees & a large section of land in the back for garden or build a studio. Plenty of room for play entertaining & garden oasis. A sense of wooded privacy in the midst of the city. Generous size 2-car garage w/built-in shelves & new overhead door. New water heater. Convenient location close to parks schools Trader Joe’s Sprouts dining Kaiser Med Ctr & EZ fwy access."

Located in Bella Riviera this 3 bed 3bath condo is in turn-key condition and has Ocean Views. Ideally located on the Upper East of Santa Barbara this spacious condo has an open kitchen dining and living room are on the main floor. The kitchen features a brand new Wolf Stove a new Bosch dishwasher and a large island. You have lovely ocean views from the balcony on the main floor. The main floor also features a guest room with a full bath and its own private entrance if desired. On the top floor you have the master and the 2nd guest room. The master bedroom has a large bathroom with double vanity and a walk-in closet. The balcony in the master bedroom has excellent ocean views. The backyard space and two-car garage are hard to find in condos on the Upper East. Showings start Sunday.

Unlimited potential with this special piece of land. A rare find and opportunity to develop a special haven for your family or a custom development. This spectacular location is removed from the street but within 6 minutes of driving distance to La Cumbre Plaza and downtown State Street. Directly adjacent to the San Marcos Foothills Nature Preserve the views are some of the best in Santa Barbara offering peace and tranquility. There has been significant investment by owners to develop the property. This property has two access driveways on each end which makes potential that much more significant for all builders and investors. A wonderful opportunity to make your dreams come true!
